item.title: MediaBox homelab — what I run in Docker (and what stayed a bookmark)
item.description: I kept a private list of self-hosted apps I wanted to try — mostly so I would stop assigning random ports and forgetting what lived on :8096. That list turned into MediaBoxDockerCompose on GitHub. This post is the short version: what I wired up, how I install on Proxmox when compose is not the right shape, and where the full port map lives so this page does not become a spreadsheet with SEO. Version française.
